verdict.rationale: Kimi Membership bundles Kimi Code, which exposes a documented API compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, with member-managed API keys in the Kimi Code Console (up to 5). However, the probe found no public API for the Kimi assistant app itself (chat, agent tasks, PPT, deep research), and the platform.kimi.ai API is a separate pay-as-you-go product. Missing for 10: a public API to drive the assistant app's features, an agent docs index or llms.txt for kimi.com, endpoint-level reference docs for the Kimi Code API, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product programmatically.
